name: Leanarr
tagline: Seed-aware library shrinker for Plex, Sonarr and Radarr.
description: Leanarr re-encodes old, inefficient video to HEVC to win back disk space, and never touches a file a torrent still needs. It starts in report mode, verifies every result, and replaces files safely.
features: Old codecs only; HDR and Dolby Vision left alone
Optional release of finished seeds per tracker rule
